raw_pattern_summary: Purchase or lawfully obtain access to an existing paid service, add setup/manual/use-case value, and sell a higher-priced self-service recurring bundle operated by one person.
reusable_pattern: existing service -> lawful resale/agency/OEM/managed-service right -> independent value add -> self-service subscription -> retained contribution margin
must_verify_before_advancement: whether login credentials may be transferred or provisioned to customers
current upstream price and volume limits
whether affiliate/referral/agency/managed-service is safer than resale
economics_rule: Do not treat 800-500=300 as economic profit. Use sale price minus upstream cost, payment fees, taxes/compliance, refunds/chargebacks, support, tooling, acquisition burden and churn effects.
why_not_micro_test_yet: The underlying service is unspecified, so resale rights, customer-account structure, fees and actual contribution margin cannot yet be verified.
